verdict.rationale: Docusign documents an official eSignature REST API and Node client to send documents for signature, plus an official MCP server that lets agents trigger IAM workflow actions. Community reports corroborate building API-driven signing integrations quickly. However, nothing shows an agent drafting an NDA through the API/MCP: AI drafting is described only for CLM clauses and MS Word review, and the MCP tool list does not explicitly include creating or sending envelopes. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP-driven NDA drafting or generation, explicit MCP send-for-signature tooling, and an end-to-end agent draft-to-signature walkthrough.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent draft an NDA and route it for signature end-to-end via the product's API or MCP server

citations.quote: The Official Docusign Node.js Client Library used to interact with the eSign REST API. Send, sign, and approve documents using this client.
